answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: (a) lacks() is a function of the files it opens, the paths it finds absent, its git reads, the ticket's crossings and its chain berths. Measured: proof_coverage.py reads os.environ only to strip git location variables (line 524) and reads no clock; crossings_for and chain_for_ticket derive from directory listings an open-hook cannot see (a NEW journal or berth), so both are re-derived at hit time and compared with the recorded values rather than trusted to the file record. (b) sys.addaudithook 'open' fires for open(), io.open and Path.read_text/read_bytes, and not for os.stat, which is why absences ride a separate recorder over the existence checks.

Horizon: the proof's run on main, then the PROVED crossing. WRONG INTENT if warm and cold findings differ on an unchanged tree.
